facts.fact: The NDPC applies the NDP Act to impose a penalty, treating it as in force.
The NDPC fined Multichoice Nigeria N766,242,500 for violating the NDP Act after an investigation begun in Q2 2024 into subscriber privacy and cross-border transfers.
The NDPC, led by National Commissioner Vincent Olatunji, issued the finding and fine.
